database: Chinook: a fictional digital music store. Customers buy tracks; each purchase is an invoice with one line per track.

columns.Title: Album title.
columns.ArtistId: The artist who released the album (Artist.ArtistId).

Track.description: Individual songs or video episodes for sale. The main product table.

columns.Name: Track title.
columns.AlbumId: Album the track belongs to (Album.AlbumId); null for singles.
columns.Composer: Composers, as free text; often null.
columns.UnitPrice: Price of the track in the store currency.

Genre.description: Musical genres, such as Rock or Jazz.

MediaType.description: File formats of tracks, such as MPEG audio file.

Playlist.description: Named playlists. The same track can be in many playlists.

columns.Name: Playlist name. Names are not unique.

PlaylistTrack.description: Link table between Playlist and Track (many to many).

Customer.description: People and companies that buy tracks. Contact columns are masked.

columns.Country: Country name, such as USA or Brazil.
columns.SupportRepId: Sales support agent responsible for the customer (Employee.EmployeeId).

Employee.description: Store staff, with a reporting hierarchy. Personal columns are masked.

columns.Title: Job title, such as Sales Support Agent.
columns.ReportsTo: Manager of the employee (Employee.EmployeeId); null for the top of the hierarchy.

Invoice.description: A purchase made by a customer. Each invoice has one or more InvoiceLine rows.

columns.InvoiceDate: Date and time of the purchase.
columns.BillingState: Billing state or province; often null.
columns.Total: Invoice total, equal to the sum of UnitPrice * Quantity of its lines.

InvoiceLine.description: One purchased track on an invoice.

columns.UnitPrice: Price of one unit when it was bought.
